description: In every PA-model, positive coprime moduli \(m,n\) and residues \(a\lt m,b\lt n\) have a simultaneous solution: some \(c\) equals \(mq+a\) and \(nr+b\) for suitable \(q,r\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.two_modulus_model.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (m n a b : M)
  (hm : m ≠ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M)
  (hn : n ≠ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M)
  (hcop : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.CoprimeModel M m n)
  (ha :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M a) m)
  (hb :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M b) n) :
  ∃ c q r,
    c =
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M m q) a ∧
      c =
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M n r) b
